'''Phre'ne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[technician]] residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Droid Technician Phre'ne was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Update 4.0. as an NPC on the fleet, who starts a short mission while unlocking multiple droid companions from the Cartel Market.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
